en.clearDialogDescription: This is an irreversible operation. Confirm that you understand the impact before continuing.
en.clearFailed: Local AWiki data could not be cleared. Deletion did not complete. Try again.
en.clearRemoteNotice: The server-side AWiki account and Handle are not deleted. You can restore the original identity from the AWiki panel with its full Handle, bound phone number, and verification code, but cleared local messages and attachment indexes cannot be restored.
en.clearScope: Only the current tenant’s locally owned DID credentials, private keys, access tokens, registration drafts, conversations, and attachment index will be deleted. Other tenants are preserved.
en.clearSucceeded: Local AWiki data was cleared. The identity can be restored with its Handle and bound phone number, but the cleared local data cannot be recovered.
en.dangerDescription: Clear only the current tenant’s local AWiki credentials and messages. Other tenants are preserved. Restoring this identity requires phone verification.

en.desktopNoRelease: No release is currently available for this channel.
en.desktopPluginCommandHelp: Open DSH Terminal from the tray, run the command, then restart Desktop.
en.desktopPluginHelp: Upgrade bundled components using a complete Desktop installer. If this tenant has no suitable installer, wait for a compatible release.
en.desktopResolvesPlugin: This Desktop update includes components meeting the current service’s recommended versions.
